revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - Yes, ἐνθῆναι and ἐνδιαθ(έτῳ) [add brackets!] are good. I agree only reluctantly with the the ed. tag. in lin1; many editors have deliberately not resolved π/, and to suggest π(αρά) (acute, since it stands on its own) is not exactly a correction.

Vote - AcceptText - BL corrections are ok. Line 1: the edition does not comment the pi, so I'm ok with the rendering of the ed. tag. Line 3: eathenai looks paleographically better than entheinai. The ny does not have such a form in this papyrus as far as I can see. Verso: endiathetw must be correct, and the ny is readable. digital photo => digital image;

Submit - There are corrections in BL 8.287. After inspecting the digital photo, I have added the corrections of lines 1: *unintelligible* (although the print. ed. has a crossed pi) to π(αρὰ), in line 2 ἐπίσκπος to ἐπίσκοπος (typo), ἐνθῆναι (l. ἐνθεῖναι) to ἐαθῆναι, and on the verso side εὐδιαθέτῳ to ἐνδιαθέτῳ. Ι have also added the seal (*unintelligible* *untelligible* in the DDbDP text, a picture of a locus sigilli in the edition)
